pr_metadata.body:
The existing Runs view now exposes exact coordinator state/generation, current readiness/fence, last update, original fault and saved recovery receipt. A current owner can explicitly recover a faulted/blocked coordinator using the exact generation and a stable tab-retained request key. After an unknown reply, the panel reads saved health without dispatching another mutation. New faults require a fresh explicit current-generation request once the old recovery is completed.

This dependent draft targets PR101 and normal-composes the whole immutable/cold recovery-ack fixes. Both coordinator operations are exactly pinned. Closed catalog/actor/body-hash/generation/readiness validation, current owner controls, bounded tab storage, stale read/write/session/navigation fences, finite request deadlines and AbortController/listener cleanup preserve the existing server authority. Coordinator health is rendered independently even when the Run list read fails. It introduces no new health-poll timer, compute retry, grant or reservation.

Local production source38c7844: controlled controller checks and2 canonical-pin unittests passed; existing mocked image-recovery browser passed. Real PostgreSQL17/Chromium151 journey passed actual separate advisory-lock timeout/fault, keyboard owner recovery, deliberately dropped successful HTTP reply, saved-read reconciliation without another POST, one first neutral GO from the original queue, unchanged admission identity and1Run/1grant/1consumption, fresh reload/mouse refresh, and1440/390 layouts. Existing real neutral publication pause/reload/same-key resume/whole-hash download browser also passed. Both fixtures closed and dropped only their owned fresh schemas.

Exact source hashes, browser/domain receipts, screenshots and retained logs: `docs/plans/lab-workflow-reliability/reports/m2-coordinator-ui/validation.json`. Independent final source/test/docs review is clear. Hosted exact-head/post-merge qualification remains pending; full M2 acceptance is not yet closed. M3 timing is active separately. These are neutral process/UI witnesses with no CUDA, model-training or scientific acceptance claim.

Independent review identified and cleared a delivery-boundary correction at exact production source3c2b8d1: a new current-generation request that never reached the server can retry its exact saved body despite an older completed receipt; an incompatible incomplete receipt remains refused. The failing witness is retained and the corrected positive/negative controller cases passed. The real PostgreSQL/Chromium coordinator journey passed again at3c2b8d1; earlier publication/browser regression evidence remains attributed to38c7844.
